method: Independent comparison of both XLSX XML packages. Human cleaning notes were not read by this script or before writing this report. Numeric values compared using exact Decimal values; strings, types, blanks, row order, headers and merged ranges checked separately. No formulas recalculated. Styles, workbook themes, chart objects and ZIP packaging are not reproduced.
cross_sheet_key_comparison: Compared identifiers as strings only for cross-sheet matching: IRN 16006 is stored numerically in Y-Maze and as text in MWM; each cleaned sheet preserves its own raw types.
